subject: SEO
label: LOCAL GOOGLE SEARCH
caption_ig:
Is your website hiding from local customers? Open your site on your phone right now. Check your browser tab and try tapping your phone number. Simple fixes like these drag buried local sites to the top of search result pages.

#localseo #smallbusinessmarketing #seotips #webdesign #localbusiness
caption_fb: Most small business owners assume getting found on Google requires expensive monthly SEO retainers. In reality, most local websites fail because of basic setup mistakes—like leaving the homepage title as 'Home' or saving contact information inside a graphic instead of plain text. When search engines scan your site, they need clear text clues about what you do and where you operate. Fixing these simple page title and content structures gives you an immediate advantage over competitors in your town.
caption_li:
Search engine optimization for local service businesses rarely requires complex technical strategies. It usually comes down to basic site clarity.

When Google crawls a site, it prioritizes structured text fields like page titles and headers. Naming your homepage 'Home' or listing four distinct services on a single landing page creates algorithmic ambiguity.

Giving each service a dedicated page and formatting your page titles with a standard [Service] + [Location] syntax removes that friction and dramatically improves local search visibility.

slides.title: Look at the browser tab on your homepage.
slides.body: If it says 'Home' or just your company name, Google treats your site like a secret. You are missing the single most heavily weighted local search ranking spot on your entire website.

slides.title: Your city is buried in a footer image.
slides.body: Google cannot read text inside images or graphic logos. If your target city only appears inside a logo or image banner, search engines assume you serve nowhere specific and drop your local ranking.

slides.title: You list five main services on one page.
slides.body: Google ranks individual pages for specific queries, not whole sites. Putting plumbing, water heaters, and drain cleaning on one page guarantees competitors with dedicated service pages outrank you every time.

slides.title: Your phone number is saved as an image.
slides.body: If mobile visitors cannot tap your phone number to call immediately, or if search engines cannot read it as editable text, potential local customers bounce and search engines miss crucial contact verification.

slides.title: Use this exact formula for your title tag.
slides.body: Change your homepage title setting to: [Primary Service] in [City, State] | [Business Name]. For example: Commercial Electrician in Denver, CO | Apex Power. This single change gives Google immediate search context.
